speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I’m Dr. Agent. To help us understand your fatigue and itching, can you tell me if you’ve noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or if your urine has become dark?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, have you noticed any pale or clay-colored stools, or does the itching feel worse at night? I would also like to know if you have experienced any abdominal pain or fever recently.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and current signs of cholestasis, I need to check for primary sclerosing cholangitis. REQUEST TEST: MRCP

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the MRCP is normal, we need to rule out autoimmune hepatitis or primary biliary cholangitis, so I will request liver autoantibodies and a liver ultrasound. Do you have any history of alcohol consumption or use of herbal supplements?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Hypertension, Ulcerative Colitis Social history: Sexually active with inconsistent condom use

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your MRCP is normal, Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis is less likely, so I need to rule out other causes of cholestasis. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Autoantibodies

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative autoantibodies and your history of inconsistent condom use, I need to rule out viral hepatitis. REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_B_and_C_Serology

speaker: Doctor
text: With PSC, autoimmune hepatitis, and viral hepatitis ruled out, I suspect drug-induced liver injury or another cholestatic process, so I need to review your medications. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Abdominal_Ultrasound: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound findings of bile duct thickening and dilatation, despite the normal MRCP, strongly suggest a focal or early cholangiopathy. Given your history of ulcerative colitis, I am highly suspicious of Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis, which can sometimes present with subtle findings on MRCP. DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis
